title: Trove time entry
description: One line of time-entries/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: one user-asserted time entry. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

id.description: source-native entry id, the dedupe key

start.description: when the entry began: RFC3339 local time, or a date-only YYYY-MM-DD for a duration-only entry the source never timestamped (Harvest "X hours on this day")

end.description: RFC3339 local time the entry stopped; omitted while a timer runs

duration_secs.description: seconds tracked; omitted while a timer runs, present for duration-only entries that have no end

description.description: the user's note for the entry

client.description: client name, verbatim (Harvest/Clockify; absent on trackers without clients)

task.description: task/sub-activity name within the project, verbatim

billable.description: whether the entry is marked billable

extra.description: everything source-specific (workspace/account id, hourly rate, rounding, invoice id, color, …)
